🔥 Hollywood में Box Office का तापमान जल्द ही काफी बढ़ने वाला है!

Timothee Chalamet की स्टारर फिल्म Dune 3 आने वाली December 18 को सिनेमाघरों में रिलीज होने के लिए पूरी तरह तैयार है। 🎬

रिपोर्ट्स के अनुसार, यह फिल्म अपने डेब्यू वीकेंड में ही $100 million से ज्यादा का घरेलू कलेक्शन कर सकती है। North America के साल 2026 के Top 5 Domestic Grossers में एंट्री करने के लिए Dune 3 को Michael फिल्म के $372.3 million के रिकॉर्ड को तोड़ना होगा। 💥

इस बार कहानी में Paul Atreides साम्राज्य पर दो दशक तक राज करने के बाद पुरानी यादों, Chani और नई खतरनाक साजिशों से जूझते हुए नजर आएंगे।

क्या आपको लगता है कि Dune 3 रिलीज होकर Michael का रिकॉर्ड तोड़ पाएगी? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय ज़रूर बताएं! 🤔

ctx.text:
Dune 3, led by Timothee Chalamet, has been generating a lot of buzz, and, along with Avengers: Doomsday, it is expected to deliver the biggest opening weekend in history. It is also expected to be the first film in the franchise to open above $100 million domestically. Therefore, it will see a solid boost in its debut weekend alone, breaking into the top 5 domestic grossers of 2026. Keep scrolling for the deets.
After a long time, Hollywood experienced a solid box-office performance in North America. So far, eight films have crossed the $200 million milestone at the domestic box office. At #5 is the musical biopic of the music legend Michael Jackson, Michael. It collected $372.3 million in its original run at the North American box office.
According to Box Office Mojo ‘s data, some of the most significant movies of the year have made it to the top 5. From Toy Story 5 to Spider-Man: Brand New Day , the top 5 is bustling with huge collections, and with Dune 3 and Avengers: Doomsday yet to come, the list will be even more vibrant.
According to the numbers provided above, Dune 3 must earn more than $372.3 million to beat Michael’s domestic haul and break into the top 5 biggest hits of the year. However, The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping releases this weekend and shows great potential. The film has already beaten Michael and The Odyssey’s opening day collections. If it beats their domestic hauls, then the list could change a bit. Beating The Odyssey seems unlikely for Dune 3.
The film follows Paul “Muad’dib” Atreides nearly two decades after seizing control of the Imperium, as he rules the Known Universe as its ruthless Padishah Emperor while grappling with the consequences of his reign. Haunted by visions of the Empire’s collapse and the return of his long-lost love, Paul finds himself caught in a dangerous conspiracy involving old allies, new threats, and Chani, forcing him to confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves. Dune 3 will be released on December 18.
